a: उपलः — 1 A stone, rock; उपलशकलेमतद्भदक गोमयानां Mu. 3. 15; कांते कथं घटितवानुपलेन चेतः Ś. Til. 3; Me. 19; Ś. 1. 14. --2 A precious stone, jewel. --3 Sand (Ved.). --4 A cloud. --ला 1 Refined sugar. --2 The upper and smaller millstone which rests on the Dṛṣad. [cf. L. opalus].

m: उप-√ लभ् Ā. -लभते, to seize, get possession of, acquire, receive, obtain, find, MBh.; R.; Mn.; Mṛcch. &c.; (with गर्भम्) to conceive, become pregnant, R.; to perceive, behold, hear [cf. Gk. ὑπολαμβάνω], to understand, learn, know, ascertain, MBh.; BhP.; Pañcat.; VarBṛS. &c.: Caus. P. -लम्भयति, to cause to obtain or take possession, BhP. viii, 15, 36; to cause to hear or learn or know, Pat. on Vārtt. 2 on Pāṇ. i, 4, 52; to cause to be known or distinguished, BhP. iv, 1, 25 : Desid. (p. -लिप्समान, AV. vi, 118, 11) to wish to catch or grasp.
a: उपलभ् — {c1c} A. 1 To know, understand, see, perceive (directly); Pt. 1. 76; अन्या प्रतिक्रिया नोपलभ्यते K. 152. --2 To ascertain, find out, learn, know; ब्रूहि यदुपलब्धं U. 1; तत्त्वत एनामुपलप्स्ये Ś. 1; Mv. 7. 30; R. 12. 60; Bk. 3. 27; K. 159; M. 4, 3. 6, 4. 6. --3 To get, obtain, acquire, enjoy, experience (happiness &c.); उपलब्धसुखः Ku. 4. 42 experiencing; कथमुपलभे निद्रां V. 2. 10 enjoy; इदानीं स्मृतिरुपलब्धा Mu. 2 now I recollect; Ms. 11. 17; R. 8. 82, 10. 2, 18. 21. --4 To conceive, become pregnant. --Caus. 1 To cause to get. --2 To produce, bring about.

उपलंभक — a. Causing to observe, reminding.
उपलंभनं — Apprehension &c.

उप-लब्धव्य mfn. to be perceived, KaṭhUp.

Comm. on Mn.; Sarvad. &c.
a: उपलक्ष् — {c10c} P. 1 To look at, observe, behold, mark; आसन्नवर्तिजन उपलक्षयति K. 197; सम्यगुपलक्षितं भवत्या Ś. 1. --2 To regard or consider; लोकप्रवादः सत्योयं पंडितैरुपलक्षितः Rām --3 To mark, put a sign upon; Y. 1. 30; 2. 151; Kām. 7. 47. --4 To denote, designate, describe. --5 To imply in addition; नक्षत्रशब्देन ज्योतिःशास्त्रमुपलक्ष्यते Kull. on Ms. 3. 162. --6 To mind, have in view; Kām. 16. 40.

designation, KātyŚr. Comm. on Pāṇ.

II. 4. 80 Sk.; so अस्ति नास्तेरुपलक्षणं &c.
